jobs.description:
Description

Squire Patton Boggs (US) LLP, a global law firm, seeks a Litigation Project Coordinator for the Los Angeles office who serves as the central coordinator for the firm's lemon law and warranty litigation practice. This role is responsible for monitoring case progress, tracking critical deadlines, overseeing client reporting requirements, and ensuring compliance with established litigation protocols. Working closely with attorneys and paralegals, the Litigation Project Coordinator helps drive efficiency, accountability, and consistency across a high-volume portfolio of consumer warranty matters.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and skilled at managing competing priorities while ensuring that cases advance in accordance with client expectations, and firm standards.

This position plays a critical role in ensuring litigation matters remain on track, reporting obligations are fulfilled, deadlines are met, and potential risks are identified before they become costly issues. Through proactive case oversight and quality assurance, the Litigation Project Coordinator helps improve client service, reduce operational inefficiencies, minimize sanctions and corrective work, and support successful outcomes for both clients and the firm.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Manage and maintain litigation tracking systems, case management reports, and matter-specific checklists.
Ensure timely completion and submission of client-required status reports, litigation updates, and other reporting obligations.
Track and communicate critical deadlines, including client related obligations, expert demands/disclosures and trial preparation milestones.
Proactively remind attorneys and legal staff of upcoming deadlines, outstanding tasks, and required case activity.
Conduct routine quality-control reviews to identify missing information, overdue assignments, potential deadline risks, and compliance concerns.
Generate performance metrics, and workload summaries for practice group leadership.
Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, and support staff to maintain consistent case progression and timely resolution of warranty claims.
Escalate high-risk matters, missed milestones, or compliance concerns to leadership for resolution.
Assist with the development and implementation of best practices, workflow improvements, and standardized litigation procedures.
Help reduce write-offs, sanctions exposure, corrective work, and administrative inefficiencies through proactive project oversight.
Support budgeting, resource planning, and operational initiatives within the lemon law practice group.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree, Paralegal Certificate, or equivalent legal experience.
Experience in litigation support and legal operations.
Experience supporting high-volume civil litigation, consumer protection, lemon law, warranty litigation, or similar practice areas preferred.
Strong understanding of litigation deadlines, court procedures, discovery processes, and case lifecycle management.
Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage numerous active matters simultaneously.
Advanced proficiency with case management, docketing, and Microsoft 365 applications.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to identify risks, solve problems proactively, and maintain strict attention to detail.

Please apply online to be considered for this position. Resumes should be accompanied by a cover letter.

California salary range for this position is $120,000 to $155,000 per year, depending on skills and experience.

Squire Patton Boggs offers comprehensive benefits, including health, dental, life, 401(k) and other benefits and an exceptional group of people with whom you will practice and develop in your career.

We are not accepting third party submissions.

Squire Patton Boggs will consider for employment qualified Applicants with Criminal Histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws.

About Squire Patton Boggs

Squire Patton Boggs is a full-service global law firm providing insight at the point where law, business and government meet, giving you a voice, supporting your ambitions and achieving successful outcomes. With over 1,500 lawyers spanning more than 40 offices across four continents, the firm is renowned for its local connections and global influence, delivering comprehensive legal services across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia Pacific, and Latin America.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion or creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other condition protected by applicable law. Job Description

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The Data Analyst II, Demand Response, reports directly to the Manager, Contract Administration & Analytics and supports CapMetro in making informed business decisions that improve the quality, efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and sustainability of the organization. This position analyzes operational, financial, contractor performance, customer service, eligibility, service coordination, and related datasets to identify trends, evaluate performance, and support timely management decisions. The position prepares routine and ad-hoc reports, analyzes key performance data, assists with National Transit Database reporting, and develops clear narratives, dashboards, scorecards, charts, and presentations for department leadership. The position uses Excel, SQL, data visualization tools, business intelligence platforms, and other analytical tools to access, validate, analyze, and present data.

Responsibilities

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Note: The duties and primary responsibilities below are intended to describe the general content of and requirements of this job and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. 

Data Analysis & Reporting

Develop, maintain, and enhance reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical tools using SQL, Excel, business intelligence platforms, and data visualization tools to support operational and financial decision-making.

Performance Monitoring & Forecasting

Analyze operational and financial performance data, including trend analysis, forecasting, projections, and cost reconciliation activities; provide actionable insights and recommendations to support departmental goals and strategic decisions.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Business Support

Partner with internal departments, contractors, and stakeholders to identify business needs, define performance measures, develop reporting solutions, and communicate analytical findings through presentations, meetings, and ongoing consultation.

Data Management & Governance

Extract, validate, organize, and analyze data from multiple systems; document data sources, definitions, methodologies, assumptions, and business requirements to ensure data integrity, consistency, and reliability.

Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

Perform quality assurance reviews of reports, dashboards, data extracts, and analytical products; identify and resolve data discrepancies and recommend process improvements to enhance reporting accuracy and efficiency.

Project & Systems Support

Coordinate analytical projects and reporting initiatives, maintain tracking of recurring and ad hoc assignments, collaborate with Information Technology on system enhancements, and support testing of software upgrades and reporting solutions.

Regulatory & Geographic Reporting

Coordinate the collection and reporting of required National Transit Database (NTD) statistics and utilize GIS and mapping tools, as needed, to analyze and visualize service performance, demand, and geographic trends.

Training, Documentation & Safety

Develop and maintain user documentation and training materials related to reports, dashboards, software applications, and compliance reporting; support a culture of safety and accessibility in the delivery of transportation services.

CapMetro Support & Other Duties Assigned

Support Capital Metropolitan Transportation Authority’s Safety Management Systems process by following safety and security policies, considering safety in every action, and reporting safety and security concerns.
Performs other duties as required.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Related experience may substitute for the education requirement on a year-for-year basis up to four (4) years.
Three (3) years of experience in operations analysis, financial analysis, business analysis, performance reporting, data analytics or related analytical role.

Intermediate skill in analyzing operational and financial data, identifying trends, developing actionable insights, and presenting findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders.
Intermediate skill in using Microsoft Excel, SQL, business intelligence platforms, data visualization tools, and other Microsoft Office applications to extract, validate, analyze, and communicate complex data.
Intermediate skill in developing dashboards, automated reports, performance metrics, and data visualizations that support operational and strategic decision-making.

Ability to communicate complex analytical information clearly and effectively through written reports, presentations, and verbal discussions.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders and contribute positively in a collaborative team environment.
Ability to leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence tools, to support data ingestion, analysis, reporting efficiency, and business process improvement.
Experience with transit operations, demand response services, scheduling and dispatch systems, call-center platforms, contract performance monitoring, public-sector reporting, GIS applications, spatial analysis, data warehouse reporting, and report automation is preferred.

About Biological Sciences

The Department of Biological Sciences focuses on three areas of research and teaching; 1) Cell and Molecular Biology – including biophysics, neuroscience, cell signaling, and developmental biology, and 2) Ecology, Biodiversity – including behavioral ecology, plant-insect interactions, conservation biology, restoration ecology, and evolution and 3) Physiology of Health and Disease including emphasis on human physiology and exercise physiology. The department offers undergraduate majors of study including Biology (B.A./B.S.), Molecular Biology (B.S./B.S.), Ecology, and Biodiversity (B.A./B.S.) Physiology of Health and Disease (B.S.) and Integrated Sciences (B.A.). A concentration in Cognitive Neurosciences (B.A./B.S.) is also offered in conjunction with the Department of Psychology. At the graduate level, the department offers M.S. and Ph.D. with a research emphasis in either cell and molecular biology or ecology and biodiversity. A professional science masters (PSM) is offered in Biomedical Sciences and a M.S. in Clinical Exercise Physiology.

About Pre-Health Education & Advising

Pre-Health Education & Advising provides academic and career advising for students from all majors who are interested in applying to medical, physician assistant, nursing, dental, pharmacy, physical therapy, and other health-related graduate programs.
